name: Muffin's Pet Connection - MAMA Program
notes: MAMA (low-cost feral spay/neuter voucher) program - flat feral package incl. rabies + eartip at participating vets; get an estimate before extra services. Also rents humane cat traps.
status_note: This programme's website now belongs to an unrelated business, and nothing shows the coupon still runs. For low-cost spay/neuter, see the guide Low-cost clinics and trap banks.

change_log.note: muffins.org, the programme's only address, is now the site of an artisan muffin bakery (read 2026-11-04), and the newest mention of the MAMA coupon anywhere is from 2009. No longer listed; nobody should be sent to the bakery.
